title: High ideal multiples intersect a submodule inside any prescribed ideal multiple
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], I ideal-sheaf data [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], H a coherent module, T a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and a:T -> H a monomorphism. For any natural number r there is a natural number k such that on every open W the intersection of the section ranges of I^k H -> H and a lies in the section range of I^r T -> T -> H. Products and powers mean the existing recursive multiplication images [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk].

source.place: Tag 01YA, affine proof and inclusion consequence, applied in Tag 01YB. Proof adapted from the proved CoherentKernelIdealIntersectionBound, replacing a kernel inclusion by an arbitrary monomorphism.

proof.text: Coherence supplies quasi-coherence and finite affine sections. Apply Mathlib Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul on each affine section module to the range of a. Choose a finite affine cover and let c be the maximum of its constants. Set k=c+r.

For a cover member with constant d<=c, Artin-Rees rewrites the intersection as I^(k-d)(I^d H intersect T). Factor k-d=r+(c-d) and use I^(c-d) T contained in T to obtain the module inclusion into I^r T.

Apply the affine ideal-intersection inclusion theorem to obtain the inclusion on all subopens of a cover member. Restrict a section in both ranges on W to the intersections of W with the covering affines.

The resulting preimages in I^r T agree on overlaps by monicity of the composite inclusion. Glue them using the sheaf axiom and use separatedness of H to check the glued section maps to the original one.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_ideal_product_intersection_bound
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H T : X.Modules) (hH : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace H)
    (a : T ⟶ H) [Mono a] (hT : T.IsQuasicoherent) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ W : X.Opens,
      Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι k).2 H).app W) ∩
          Set.range (a.app W) ⊆
        Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι r).2 T ≫
          a).app W)
